title: Inside an AI Agent
subtitle: How a model turns a request into a grounded result

blocks.title: The agent loop
blocks.diagram:
flowchart LR
  U[User goal] --> A[Agent]
  A --> M[Model plans]
  M --> D{Need a tool?}
  D -- Yes --> T[Tool executes]
  T --> O[Result observed]
  O --> M
  D -- No --> R[Answer]

blocks.title: A tool-assisted turn
blocks.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant App
  participant Model
  participant Tool
  User->>App: Goal
  App->>Model: Decide next step
  Model-->>App: Tool call
  App->>Tool: Execute
  Tool-->>App: Result
  App->>Model: Observe
  Model-->>App: Answer
  App-->>User: Response

blocks.title: The application keeps control
blocks.text: A tool call is a proposal from the model. The host application checks permissions, validates arguments, applies timeouts, and decides what result returns to the model.

blocks.label: steps in one agent turn
blocks.detail: Receive, decide, act, and respond—repeating when the task needs another step.

blocks.title: What shapes the next action
blocks.text: The agent combines the current request with conversation state, retrieved evidence, system instructions, and tool results. Context is assembled for each model turn; tools extend what the system can observe or do.
